fighter.question1: I want to participate in an event. How do I do that?
fighter.question2: Can I choose an opponent if I apply for a fight?
fighter.question3: How can I start earning money?
fighter.answer3: Fans4 is the only platform to offer financial reward to our fighters. You will receive money for every fan that subscribes to your Fans4 page. Be sure to invite followers who will support you via your own personalied QR code found in the app (Profile > Settings > Invite a Fan > scan the QR code). Be an active user on our app, post quality content, apply for fights and participate in events so fans stay tuned to your content.
fighter.answer4: You will need to add your bank account details in order to receive payment. Go to Profile > Settings > Finances > Add bank account and follow the instructions. The more fans you have, the more you earn!

fan.question1: How can I subscribe to fighter?
fan.answer1: To subscribe to a fighter, please visit the fans4.com official website. For now, you can't subscribe to a Fighter in the app. We know it’s a hassle. But after you subscribe, you can enjoy all the exclusive content in the app!
fan.question2: Why are some features not available to me?
fan.answer2: Some features are only available with subscription. For example, viewing fighter's content or proposing a fight with that fighter is only available once you are subscribed.
fan.question3: How can I propose a fight?
fan.answer3: You can propose a fight only with the fighters who you are subscribed to. To do this, go to Voting > Propose > Choose your Fighter > Next > Choose opponent > Submit. Once approved, you will be able to vote your fighter in for the next event. Be sure to track the proposal status on 'Your Proposals' tab on the Voting page.
